scope.geometry: All currently visible geometry and exact instance matrices; no photograph or replacement geometry

excluded.name: procedural-golden-cloud-atmosphere
excluded.reason: Non-PBR shader has no automatic portable equivalent

excluded.name: actual-pond-reflection
excluded.reason: Planar approximation replaced by physical surface reflection in path tracer

physicalSurfaceReplacement.sourceGeometry: Existing Three.js water plane and scene02-water PBR/bump data
physicalSurfaceReplacement.material: Cycles Principled water, IOR 1.333, source procedural ripple bump and physical scene reflection

worldCoordinateConversion: All source meshes, lights and camera jointly rotated +90 degrees about X: Y-up to Z-up, no deformation.

outdoorSky.source: Blender atmospheric scattering with a code-generated directional 3D noise cloud field; no bitmap background

scene02SkyDome.source: Code port of the existing scene02 ShaderMaterial sky: analytic horizon gradient, exact source sun vector, 10-step cloud scattering/self-shadow; no photograph or generated replacement frame
scene02SkyDome.UV: Hand-authored equirectangular coordinates on a Y-up to Z-up converted sphere
scene02SkyDome.radiance: Linear float texture generated at render time and used as an emissive 3D environment shell

explicitSunDisc.source: Original scene02 procedural sky shader sun vector, oriented through the manually observed 10.2%/33.5% reference sky point
explicitSunDisc.halo: No circular proxy halo; the Blender atmosphere supplies scattering.

materialTransfer: Original portable PBR parameters and source procedural textures; custom GLSL not portable. Planar approximations replaced by physical reflection.

lightCalibration.transfer: Source positions/colors; area*pi and point*4pi power conversion
